shortDescription: 8-week four-day lower and upper hypertrophy base-building split.
descriptionHtml:
8-week four-day lower and upper hypertrophy base-building split.

Structure: 8 weeks, 4 scheduled sessions per week, 42 referenced exercise ids.

Weekly split: Lower Body #1, Upper Body #1, Lower Body #2, and Upper Body #2.

  • Goal: hypertrophy
  • Level: beginner
  • Duration: 8 weeks
  • Tags: lower upper and 4 days per week
